description:
auth_proof for a remembered browser. proof: base64url (no padding) of HMAC-SHA256 keyed with SHA-256(token) over "go-link-desk link proof
" + nonce. proof2 (bound_cases), the same tied to the connection: over "go-link-desk link proof 2
" + nonce + "
" + host fingerprint + "
" + viewer fingerprint, each the SDP's first sha-256 a=fingerprint as "sha-256 " + upper-case hex. Read by backend-device, frontend, iOS and Android tests.

fingerprint_cases.sdp:
v=0
o=- 1 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
a=fingerprint:sha-512 AA:BB
a=fingerprint:SHA-256 ab:cd:ef
m=application 9 UDP/DTLS/SCTP webrtc-datachannel
